# Track company assets and equipment

[Overview](#overview) · [Before you start](#before-you-start) · [Steps](#steps-at-a-glance)

## Overview

When buying, assigning, moving, returning or disposing of company equipment. A reconciled asset register with accountable custodians and verified authorized disposal or return.

Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.

> This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.

## Step details

<a id="step-1"></a>

### 1. Build the asset and custody register

agent-runnable


Record the equipment, serial or asset identifier, purchase evidence, custodian, location and relevant warranty. Distinguish owned, leased, customer and personally owned property.

- Sources: [SBA manage your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/manage-your-business/) · [FTC cybersecurity for small business](https://www.ftc.gov/business-guidance/small-businesses/cybersecurity)

<a id="step-2"></a>

### 2. Approve purchasing and handling responsibilities

human · human approval required


The accountable owners confirm assignment, physical security, maintenance, insurance and return expectations. Use the payment and purchasing approval process for new commitments.

- Sources: [SBA manage your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/manage-your-business/) · [FTC cybersecurity for small business](https://www.ftc.gov/business-guidance/small-businesses/cybersecurity)

<a id="step-3"></a>

### 3. Record approved assignment and configuration

manual form/portal · human approval required · hard to undo


Authorized operators tag assets, issue equipment and link it to the relevant access or device-management controls. Verify receipt and document exceptions without exposing credentials in the asset record.

- Sources: [SBA manage your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/manage-your-business/) · [FTC cybersecurity for small business](https://www.ftc.gov/business-guidance/small-businesses/cybersecurity)

<a id="step-4"></a>

### 4. Reconcile physical holdings and changes

human · human approval required


Custodians confirm assets, condition and location on the agreed cadence. Investigate missing equipment and coordinate lost-device or security response where needed.

- Sources: [SBA manage your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/manage-your-business/) · [FTC cybersecurity for small business](https://www.ftc.gov/business-guidance/small-businesses/cybersecurity)

<a id="step-5"></a>

### 5. Authorize return, reuse or disposal

human · human approval required


Verify ownership, retention needs and data sanitization before transfer or disposal. Retain return or disposal evidence and reconcile the asset, accounting and access records.

- Verify: A reconciled asset register with accountable custodians and verified authorized disposal or return.
- Sources: [SBA manage your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/manage-your-business/) · [FTC cybersecurity for small business](https://www.ftc.gov/business-guidance/small-businesses/cybersecurity)
